tasks.label: EsmatPlastic: Start API
tasks.command: $apiListener = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5023 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($apiListener) { try { $health = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:5023/api/health/status' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 3; if ($health.status -eq 'Healthy') { Write-Output 'Now listening on: http://localhost:5023 (reusing healthy API)'; exit 0 } } catch {}; throw 'Port 5023 is already in use by an unhealthy or unrelated service.' }; if (Test-Path '.env.local') { Get-Content '.env.local' | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match '^(.*?)=(.*)$') { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($matches[1].Trim(), $matches[2].Trim('"'), 'Process') } } }; dotnet run --project 'EsmatPlastic.API/EsmatPlastic.API.csproj' -p:BaseOutputPath=bin\VSCodeTask\

tasks.label: EsmatPlastic: Start Desktop Visible
tasks.command: $desktopProcess = Get-Process -Name 'EsmatPlastic.Desktop' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if ($desktopProcess -and $desktopProcess.MainWindowHandle -ne 0) { Write-Output '__ESMATPLASTIC_DESKTOP_READY__'; Wait-Process -Id $desktopProcess.Id; exit 0 }; if ($desktopProcess) { Stop-Process -Id $desktopProcess.Id -Force; $desktopProcess.WaitForExit() }; dotnet build 'EsmatPlastic.Desktop/EsmatPlastic.Desktop.csproj'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $desktopPath = Join-Path (Get-Location) 'EsmatPlastic.Desktop/bin/Debug/net9.0-windows/EsmatPlastic.Desktop.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $desktopPath)) { throw 'Desktop executable was not produced by the build.' }; $startedProcess = Start-Process -FilePath $desktopPath -WorkingDirectory (Join-Path (Get-Location) 'EsmatPlastic.Desktop') -PassThru; $deadline = [DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(60); $desktopWindow = $null; do { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; $desktopWindow = Get-Process -Name 'EsmatPlastic.Desktop' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowHandle -ne 0 } | Select-Object -First 1; $startedProcess.Refresh() } while (-not $desktopWindow -and -not $startedProcess.HasExited -and [DateTime]::UtcNow -lt $deadline); if (-not $desktopWindow) { throw 'Desktop process started but did not create a visible main window.' }; Write-Output '__ESMATPLASTIC_DESKTOP_READY__'; Wait-Process -Id $desktopWindow.Id
